summary: Re-tested iter17 fixes. The specific toast fix (CartContext using ProductImage) IS working correctly. However, TWO other claimed fixes are NOT actually applied in code: (a) 'COA included' is still present in ProductCard.jsx line 39 and is visible on every product card in the UI; (b) ProductCard, CartDrawer, and ProductDetail still use raw tags without ProductImage/onError fallback — they were never migrated. Currently no product image URL is 404 so the missing fallback doesn't visually manifest on catalog, but the resilience the fix promised is not in place.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Toast fallback IS verified working (add-to-cart-toast uses ProductImage; verified via x-component attribute and 0 broken imgs in toast).
